name: local GPU / llm live smoke

runtime.name: vllm-openai
runtime.config: docker run -d --name metrum-live-llm --gpus device=0 --ipc=host -p 8000:8000 -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0 Qwen/Qwen3-8B --reasoning-parser qwen3 --max-model-len 32768

notes: vLLM 0.31.0 (released 2026-10-04) Qwen3-8B, --reasoning-parser qwen3 --max-model-len 32768 per vLLM reasoning docs and the Qwen3-8B model card (researched 2026-10-05); epic #184 live validation on 1x H100 PCIe (Scaleway via Shadeform)
